mapper.select: SELECT uf.id, uf.user_id, uf.attraction_id, a.name as attractionName, a.city, SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.images, ',', 1) as attractionImage, uf.visit_date, uf.note, uf.create_time FROM user_footprint uf LEFT JOIN attraction a ON uf.attraction_id = a.id WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uf.visit_date DESC, uf.create_time DESC
